text:
Gavin L.: Heads-up: were formally deprecating the old "sync" SDK packages (python-sync and @redwood/inference-sync) in favor of the unified async-first SDK (v4). Announcing the plan and migration support now so teams can schedule upgrades. :loudspeaker:
Marta B.: are we removing sync support entirely or shipping shims?
Gavin L.: Were removing the published sync packages in two phases: 1) deprecate (npm/pypi warnings + docs) starting today, 2) unpublish legacy sync packages 90 days after v4 GA. The v4 SDK includes a compatibility wrapper `sync_bridge` for blocking callsites to migrate with minimal changes.
Ken H.: quick examples for teams that cant move to async right away?
Gavin L.: Sure, pin to the last sync-friendly patch for zero-change, or add `sync_bridge`. Examples below.

```
# pin to last sync patch (requirements.txt)
redwood-sdk-sync==2.8.7

# node package.json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/inference-sync": "2.8.7"
}
```

```
# python: quick sync_bridge usage
from redwood import Client
from redwood.sync_bridge import run_sync
client = Client(api_key=...)
# existing blocking code
resp = run_sync(client.generate, "Hello world", max_tokens=50)
```

Gavin L.: The sync_bridge is a thin adapter that runs the async runtime on a background loop and preserves blocking semantics for common patterns. Its intended as a short-term bridge, not a permanent compatibility layer.
docs-bot: Migration guide + sync_bridge docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/sync-deprecation (includes codemod, CI recipes, and canary checklist)
Marta B.: how do we handle libraries that import the sync package (transitive deps)?
Gavin L.: We added a `compat-redirect` entry in v4 that forwards imports for known module paths and prints a clear warning at import time. For enterprise/private customers with strict offline repos, theres an opt-in legacy package mirror in the console.
Ken H.: testing and CI suggestions?
Gavin L.: Add `redwood-sync-check` to CI which runs the quick smoke harness and the codemod in dry-run mode. Example GH Action in the migration doc: run the codemod, run `pytest --sync-check` and fail if any deprecated imports remain.
QA-Bot: Quick test snippet: `pip install redwood-sync-check && redwood-sync-check run --path=src/`
Iris Y.: telemetry or usage signals so we know how many callsites are impacted?
Gavin L.: We built an opt-in scanner that fingerprints import patterns and common blocking call signatures (no request payloads). Playbook has a BigQuery query to estimate counts. Opt-in telemetry only.
Marta B.: what about customers running Dedicated / Private?
Gavin L.: Hosted customers will get a temporary runtime shim for 60 days post-GA to accept sync APIs; Dedicated/Private customers must deploy the shim themselves or run the sync_bridge. We documented admin flags for Dedicated in the console docs.
Ken H.: rollback strategy if upgrade causes regressions?
Gavin L.: Keep pins in place, revert clients to the pinned package, or enable the console mirror/legacy flag. Well coordinate emergency re-publishes if necessary. Ping #eng-runtime with label `sdk-sync-rollback`.
Iris Y.: timeline summary?
Gavin L.: Deprecation notice: today. Docs + codemod + sync_bridge: shipping in next 48 hours. Deprecation window (unpublish legacy packages): starts 90 days after v4 GA. Hosted shim: available for 60 days post-GA. Exact sunset dates will be published in the migration doc.
Marta B.: can you include a codemod example to convert blocking calls to await-based code? That will help infra teams doing repo-wide upgrades.
Gavin L.: Yes  codemod `redwood-convert-sync` available: `npx redwood-convert-sync ./src --dry-run` and a Python refactor script for common patterns. Docs include before/after snippets.
Ken H.: who do teams ping for support during migration?
Gavin L.: Ping @gavin or post in #eng-runtime and open an issue with label `sdk-sync-deprecate`. Docs team will triage migration PR reviews if you tag them.
docs-bot: Migration doc + codemod + sync_bridge: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/sync-migration-guide
Marta B.: thanks 44d Ill schedule the codemod run on our monorepo and add the sync_check to CI this week.
Gavin L.: TL;DR: 1) Deprecating sync packages; 2) Use sync_bridge or pin to last patch for immediate stability; 3) Run codemod + CI checks for repo upgrades; 4) Hosted shim available short-term; 5) Contact #eng-runtime for urgent rollbacks.
